faqLeft.q: What engine does the Jaguar XJR use?
faqLeft.a: It depends on the generation. The X300 (1994-1997) uses the AJ16 4.0-litre supercharged inline-six. The X308 (1997-2003) uses a 4.0-litre supercharged V8 (AJ-V8). The X350 (2002-2009) uses a 4.2-litre supercharged V8 (AJ-V8). The X351 (2009-2019) uses the 5.0-litre supercharged V8 (AJ133S). Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your car has.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Jaguar XJR engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds for the supercharged V8 models start from £5,500. Pricing for the early AJ16 is confirmed on registration - submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my XJR?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the AJ16, AJ-V8 or AJ133S before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild AJ133S XJR engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace the timing chain, tensioners, guides and water pump as standard on every AJ133S rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild AJ-V8 supercharged XJR engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We inspect and replace worn components as part of the rebuild, though this engine family does not share the AJ133S timing chain design flaw.

faqRight.q: Do you rebuild AJ16 XJR engines?
faqRight.a: Yes. We rebuild the early supercharged six-cylinder to the same standard as our V8 work.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used XJR engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my XJR if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes - nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an XJR engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most XJR owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty - often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
